name: dj-ai
description: Cursor-like AI coding assistant with your own API

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dj-ai/shared && npm run build -w @dj-ai/api && npm run build -w @dj-ai/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dj-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dj-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dj-ai/api && npm run typecheck -w @dj-ai/extension
